definitions.gloss: era, epoch, the beginning of an era
definitions.explanation: The starting point of a calendar system or historical era. Often refers to the beginning of the Common Era (A.D.) or the founding of a civilization.

definitions.gloss: A.D., the year (of the Common Era)
definitions.explanation: Used with year numbers to indicate dates in the Western calendar system. Often contrasted with {紀元前|きげんぜん} (B.C.).

examples.japanese: {紀元|きげん}⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: Study history from around the beginning of the Common Era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皇紀|こうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神武天皇|じんむてんのう}{即位|そくい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紀元|きげん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japan's imperial calendar takes the enthronement of Emperor Jimmu as its epoch.

examples.japanese: ⟦キリスト{教|きょう}→キリスト教：10823_kirisutokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、イエス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生|たんじょう}→誕生：01460_tanjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{紀元|きげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧になっている。
examples.english: In the Christian calendar, the birth of Jesus serves as the reference point for the era.

examples.japanese: {紀元|きげん}79⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ポンペイ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滅|ほろ}びた→滅びる：10881_horobiru⟧。
ローマ⟦{帝国|ていこく}→帝国：12420_teikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紀元|きげん}476⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{滅亡|めつぼう}→滅亡：13360_metsubou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Roman Empire fell in 476 A.D.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紀元|きげん}3⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧ごろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{推定|すいてい}→推定：04293_suitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: These ruins are estimated to date from around the 3rd century A.D.

notes:
USAGE:
{紀元|きげん} by itself typically refers to the Common Era (A.D.). To specify B.C., use ⟦{紀元前|きげんぜん}→紀元前：13831_kigenzen⟧. In academic and historical writing, {紀元|きげん} may be abbreviated as {紀元|きげん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (A.D.) to contrast with ⟦{紀元前|きげんぜん}→紀元前：13831_kigenzen⟧ (B.C.).

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (deadline, time limit) or ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧ (mood, humor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{紀元前|きげんぜん}→紀元前：13831_kigenzen⟧: B.C., before the Common Era
- {紀元後|きげんご}: A.D., after the Common Era
- {紀元|きげん}○⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: year ○ A.D.
- {皇紀|こうき}: Japanese imperial era dating
